note: Dallam County (TX) does not publish a zoning district layer; Texas counties generally do not zone unincorporated land. The only city zoning source found is Dalhart's Zoning Map, published as a PDF (linked from the city's Forms and Documents page), with no queryable polygon service. The county's ArcGIS Online item (DallamCADAdditionalData) holds only boundary, flood, soils, cemetery and address layers, no zoning. No Dalhart zoning ArcGIS layer was found in ArcGIS search.
